svg.aria-label: Left: AE codes and VAE means for 360 test images; colors are true digits used only for visualization. Dashed VAE circles have radii one and two. Right: 121 decoder means on a grid from −2.5 to 2.5 in both coordinates, spacing 0.5. The scatterplots use their own coordinate ranges; AE and VAE values are not identified with one another.
